description.description: This is a series of four frames from a video showing a map of the United Kingdom and Ireland being colored by hand to represent 'Immigrant Distribution'. The map includes a legend with markers for 'Epicenter' (Black), 'Quite High' (Orange), 'Over 35%' (Red), 'Moderate' (Blue), and 'No Immigrants' (Green). In the first frame, a person uses a green marker to shade the northwest coast of Scotland. In the second frame, the person shades the coast of Western Ireland with green. In the third frame, a hand wearing a black glove uses a blue marker to color areas on the east coast of England. In the fourth frame, the blue marker is being used on the west coast of Ireland.
